desc: Ideation: bottom-up DP with cost0/cost1 per subtree, O(3^N) time
Implement final solution with fast input parsing (sys.stdin.buffer.read().split(), join tokens) and explicit opposite-root answer
Validate recurrence against brute force for N=1 and small N=2 cases (all zeros, all ones, alternating, sample 1)
Confirm memory strategy: two int lists of length 3^N (~1.6M) are acceptable; fall back to array('i') only if needed
Leaf init: `cost0 = bit value` (0 for '0', 1 for '1'), `cost1 = 1 - cost0` — correct.
Recurrence: forcing output 0 requires ≥2 of 3 children to output 0; the four `min` candidates (all-zero + three exactly-two-zero combos) cover all cases — correct and symmetric for output 1.
Answer: `max(cost0[0], cost1[0])` equals the cost of forcing the opposite root value, since the current root value always has cost 0 — correct.
N=1 "010": cost0=0 (children 0,2 already 0), cost1=1 → answer 1, matches brute force ✓
Sample 1 yields 1 per the worker's trace ✓
Complexity O(3^N) time with shrinking levels; peak memory is two ~1.6M-element lists, acceptable for N ≤ 13.
